learning: Iterations 0 to 7 show that pitch, footprint at 12 and 16 mm, track, gain, mass, wheel_radius and lead each leave max_error at the off-track floor with one line loss per run. If line_loss_events falls to 0 with max_error below 0.06 m, footprint was the limit and the next test is further lead (y = 0.08 m). If one loss per run persists, the footprint lever is exhausted and the remaining limit lies outside geometry.
notes: Footprint-only test from the iteration 7 design: sensor_size 0.016 to 0.008 m, with sensor pitch, lead (y = 0.06 m), track, wheel radius, mass and controller unchanged. Built to test whether the finer footprint clears the single line loss per run that persisted through every other geometry change.
rationale: Iteration 7 (y = 0.06 m, 16 mm footprint) scored 53.4013 with max_error still at the 0.061 to 0.067 m off-track floor and one line loss per run. Lead and footprint sizes 12 to 16 mm have each been tested, so the 8 mm footprint is the one untested sensor lever. The geometry is exactly the Builder's entity0: the iteration 7 geometry with sensor_size changed from 0.016 to 0.008 m, and nothing else changed. The controller is held at the iteration 7 values (kp 1.4, ki 0.05, kd 0.15, base_speed 1.6, sensor_weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], last_direction), so any change in line_loss_events or max_error is attributable to footprint. Risk: an 8 mm footprint covers only about a third of the 25 mm tape per sensor, so readings may fall below the 0.05 line-loss threshold sooner at moderate offsets. I expect line_loss_events to move toward 0 only if the outer sensors were losing tape early, and I am not confident this happens. controller_errors is requested to catch any integration fault.
